REPORT
Date September 21, 1937
Subject Arrival of P. Saratovtseff, Soviet diplomatic official.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by C. Crawford DJ
Mr. P.G. Saratovtseff, 39, First Secretary and
Chief of Press Department of the U.S.S.R. Embassy in China,
returned to Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. via Japan on September 17,
1937 in the s.s. D'Artagnan.
He is accompanied by his wife, Mrs H. Saratovtseff.
They reside at 169 Route Winling, apart. 14.
J. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
D. C. ( Crime & Special Branches)
Copy sent to "O".
File 21/9

日期：1937年9月21日
事由：苏联外交官员 P. Saratovtseff 抵沪。
制作人：D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人：C. Crawford DJ

P.G. Saratovtseff 先生，39岁，苏联驻华大使馆一等秘书兼新闻处处长，于1937年9月17日乘坐“达达尼昂”号（s.s. D'Artagnan）轮船，经日本从苏联返回上海。
其妻 H. Saratovtseff 夫人随行。
他们居住在林森路（Route Winling）169号14室。

J. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
副总监（刑事与特务科）
副本已送交“O”。

Date July 30, 1935.

Subject P. Saratovtsev, Soviet diplomatic official.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by

With reference to endorsement by Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch) on the attached report, I have to state
that all endeavours to obtain the description of Saratovtsev
failed to produce any result.
Saratovtsev is still residing in the premises of the
Soviet Consulate-General, No. 1 Whangpoo Road.

D. S. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

Subject ...... P. Saratovtsev, Soviet diplomatic official.

Made by ... D.S. Tcheremshansky. ...... Forwarded by ... B. B. Everson. OO

Pavel Saratovtsev, 37, reported to be a member of
Soviet diplomatic staff in China, arrived in Shanghai from
Moscow via Japan on May 21, 1935 in the s.s. "Sever,"
accompanied by his wife, Mrs. Helena Saratovtsev, 36.
He holds diplomatic passport No.3201 issued by the
People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs on April 11, 1935, at
Moscow. This passport bears a visa issued by the Chinese
Embassy in Moscow on April 17, 1935.
Saratovtsev gave his address as U.S.S.R. Consulate-
General at Shanghai.

D. S. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).
S2
Please endeavour
to obtain a rough description
of him.
J.P.
25 MAY 1935

帕维尔·萨拉托夫采夫（Pavel Saratovtsev），37岁，据报为苏联驻华外交人员，于1935年5月21日乘坐“谢韦尔”号（s.s. "Sever"）轮船，经日本从莫斯科抵达上海，其妻海伦娜·萨拉托夫采娃（Helena Saratovtsev）夫人，36岁，随行。
他持有1935年4月11日由苏联外交人民委员部在莫斯科签发的第3201号外交护照。该护照上贴有1935年4月17日由中国驻莫斯科大使馆签发的签证。
萨拉托夫采夫提供的地址为上海苏联总领事馆。

D. S. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

副总监（特务科）。
S2
请设法
获取其大致外貌描述。
J.P.
1935年5月25日
1935年5月27日
